title: Satavahana administration and economy: more detail

boxes.title: Kingship & rulers
items: King = ==upholder of dharma==; titles **Maharaja**, **Raja-Raja**; hereditary, patriarchal
**Kuntala Satakarni** (**13th**): ==Sanskrit the royal language==; court of Gunadhya, Sarvavarma
Hala's court: poets **Kumarila**, **Sripalita**; ==golden age of Prakrit==
Hala wed Lilavati at **Bhimeswara** temple, **Draksharamam**
Yajna Sri "Trisamudradhipati" per **Harshacharita** (Banabhatta)

boxes.title: Units, feudatories, army
items: Aharas named: **Satavahani**, Sopara, **Mamala**, Kodura, **Vaijayanti**; Amatyas not hereditary
**Rajakambata** = king's core territory (APP: Rajakhankheta)
Village heads often military, post hereditary → feudalism; Myakadoni = Pulumavi's **8th** year
Feudatories: ==**Chutus** (Mysore), **Kuras** (Kolhapur), **Ikshvakus** (Vijayapuri)==
**Mahabhojas** (Konkan) omit emperor's name; Maharathi **Sadakana Chutukadananda** issued coins
Battle order (Amaravati sculptures): infantry front, cavalry & elephants flanks, archers rear

boxes.title: Grants & agriculture
items: Naneghat: Satakarni I gave land, cows (**godhana**), gold to Brahmins
Gautamiputra's Nasik grant immunities: ==no entry for royal officers/soldiers==, no salt digging
Grants = root of early-medieval feudal order
Krishna-Godavari basin: ==**paddy transplantation**==; **rice**, **cotton**
Guild head **jetthaka** (Pali); guilds in all India, not only north (RPSC **2018**)

boxes.title: Roman trade & coins: added
items: Exports: muslin (**Mallaselai**), pepper, ==**Wootz steel**==; imports: wine, gold, **camphor** (China)
Roman coins: **Attirala**, **Salihundam**, Vijayawada; **Constantine** coin at Kudali Sangameswaram
Periplus: Arikamedu "market street of the Romans"
Yajna Sri's ship-with-anchor: trade with **Siam**, **Java**, **Borneo**
Jogalthambi hoard: ==**13,270** coins==; motifs: **Ujjain symbol**, chaitya; mint legend "Siri Chimuka Sata"
Punch-marked first, then die-struck; ⚠ copper-coated iron coins = **Shalankayanas**

boxes.title: Language, society, books
items: **Desi Bhaasha** of common people; Salankayanas: Sanskrit official (**5** of **8** inscriptions)
More Desi words: **Pandi**, **Pilla**, **Tuppu**; Telugu = "Italian of the East"
Gathasaptasati: opens with prayer to **Shiva**; ==first with all **Navarasas**==; **Brundagana**, sati, no child marriage
Gunadhya began **burning** the Brihatkatha; adaptations: **Kshemendra**, **Buddhasvami**, **Durvinita**
**Harivijaya** (Sarvasena); **Kamasutra** (Vatsyayana): women's vetti
**Gundaram** (Telangana) Satavahana inscriptions found (**2026**)
